study_type: retrospective speaker-disjoint development study; historical outer results previously inspected
graph_prior: fixed generic; all OK/SUB/DEL and at most two insertions per gap
classifier_selection: development-patient average precision; ties use listed order
calibration: Platt fit on development patient only; no test refit
threshold: development F1 maximum among 0.01,...,0.99, ties nearest 0.5
diagnosis: training-only SUB-versus-DEL logistic C=0.1; train CF is cross-fitted
one_pass_policy: Write all outer predictions before reading test labels for metrics. No changes selected from outer results. Report every registered method and ablation.
